description: Source file implementing the MidiManager class for MIDI device management, including session handling, port management, and event reporting.

classes.name: MidiManager
classes.description: Manages MIDI sessions, ports, and data transmission, with event reporting and thread safety.

methods.name: MidiManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MIDI manager with a service.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.description: Begins a MIDI session with a client, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: EndSession
methods.description: Ends a MIDI session for a client.

methods.name: HasOpenSession
methods.description: Checks if there are active MIDI sessions.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Placeholder for sending MIDI data, not implemented.

methods.name: AddInputPort
methods.description: Adds an input port and notifies clients.

methods.name: AddOutputPort
methods.description: Adds an output port and notifies clients.

methods.name: SetInputPortState
methods.description: Sets the state of an input port.

methods.name: SetOutputPortState
methods.description: Sets the state of an output port.

methods.name: GetOutputPortState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of an output port.

methods.name: AccumulateMidiBytesSent
methods.description: Tracks bytes sent for a client.

methods.name: ReceiveMidiData
methods.description: Handles incoming MIDI data and notifies clients.

methods.name: GetClientCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns number of active clients (test only).

methods.name: GetPendingClientCountForTesting
methods.description: Returns number of pending clients (test only).
